pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   C. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.
   D. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   B. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.
   C. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   D. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

10. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   C. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.
   D. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Response to Modern Medicine, Science and Technology Page 14 of 95 1 ST and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Response to Modern Medicine, Science and Technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
